title: C6 Document Verification Result
description: Output of document verification adapter or registry gateway (Guide §1.3, §3.4 C6). Distinct from rule check result.

document_type.description: Classification of the document (e.g. fire_noc, building_plan, affidavit)

adapter.description: Adapter implementation name (e.g. qr_registry_sim, digilocker_mock, manual_officer)

source.description: Issuing authority or registry source queried (e.g. mock-issuer registry, simulated state fire service)

simulated.description: MUST be true for any mocked, simulated, or sandbox issuer connection

status.description: Document verification status per Guide §1.3. Separate from rule check results.

request_digest.description: Hash of outgoing query payload for non-repudiation

response_digest.description: Hash of response body received from source

checked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of verification query

compared.description: Field-by-field comparison between document and issuer registry response
